tools.name: get_health
tools.description: Health check for Housewarming Kit gift inspiration. Returns ok, storage, paapi, trackingTag, defaultDomain, catalogCount, and marketplaces[] (domain, label, tagConfigured). Use first to discover storefronts. OpenAPI: getHealth.

tools.name: list_marketplaces
tools.description: List supported Amazon storefronts (domain, label, currencyHint, tagConfigured). Agents MUST pick the user's marketplace and pass it on search/catalog/resolve. tagConfigured is false until real Associates IDs exist (buyUrl omits ?tag=).

tools.name: search_kits
tools.description: Search Amazon for first-apartment / housewarming essentials on the user's marketplace. Returns PA-API products when configured, otherwise search deep-link cards (buyUrl, trackingTag) + catalogMatches. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale. OpenAPI: searchAmazon.

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: Paginated curated housewarming starters. On amazon.se items may include /dp/ASIN buy links; elsewhere catalogMode is search-ideas. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale. Search remains primary. OpenAPI: getCatalog.

tools.name: resolve_product
tools.description: Resolve an ASIN, pasted Amazon /dp/ URL, or keywords to buyUrl (product /dp or apartment search). ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale. Does not invent Associates tags — trackingTag is null until configured. OpenAPI: resolveProduct.

tools.name: create_kit
tools.description: Create a housewarming / first-apartment kit list. Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, shopUrl, wishlist, storage. Save editToken for add_kit_item. Prefer create_and_fill for one-shot. OpenAPI: createWishlist.

tools.name: create_and_fill
tools.description: One call: create a curated housewarming / moving in gift wishlist and return shopUrl (share link) + ownerUrl. Preferred agent path: create a kit and add ASINs / keywords / search queries in one call. Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, shopUrl. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale. OpenAPI: agentCreateAndF

tools.name: get_kit
tools.description: Fetch a kit by id. Returns wishlist items with buyUrl/linkType when available, plus ownerUrl and shopUrl. OpenAPI: getWishlist.

tools.name: add_kit_item
tools.description: Add an item to a kit. Requires editToken from create. Body: name/title plus asin, url (pasted /dp), searchKeywords, or catalogId. Token storage may return a new id — update bookmarks. OpenAPI: addWishlistItem.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: resolve_product · Private data: add_kit_item · Public sink: create_and_fill.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: resolve_product · Private data: add_kit_item · Public sink: create_and_fill

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
